positive_snippets: Had a really very comfortable 3 nights stay at CRS Inn. The rooms are quite spacious, with all the amenities. Cleanliness of the room, washroom, and the premices is very very good. There was a huge TV inside the room, to keep us entertained. The owner and staff are very kind and helpful. It is located in a very posh neighbourhood, very accessible from highway. It is close to IFFCO Chowk, M.G. Road Metro, and ambiance mall. Airport is roughly 30-40 mins away (except peak hours of traffic)10/10 marks for Poha, Aloo Paratha, and Dal. Please do visit this place, you'll have a very amazing stay. Highly recommend!

I stayed at CRS Inn, and this is my genuine review based on real experiences. I travel frequently for business, and I’ve stayed at many properties — but this one truly stands out.

The staff is polite, and the manager is extremely helpful and cooperative. The room was one of the cleanest I’ve ever stayed in, and the overall property is beautiful. The ambiance is so peaceful and refreshing that I actually extended my stay. The hotel is budget-friendly, surrounded by greenery, and the accommodation feels very nature-friendly. Every piece of furniture, including the curtains, has a royal touch.

I’ve encountered many situations in the past where I paid more but ended up with dirty rooms elsewhere, so finding a property this clean and well-maintained feels worth appreciating. I want this review to help genuine travelers who value cleanliness and service.

I had only the breakfast, which was healthy, served in a buffet style, and complimentary with the room.

A small but important note for travelers:
If you’re checking in after 10:30 PM, please call the hotel once. The main society gate closes after 10:30 PM, so after that time, use Gate No. 2, opposite Sahara Mall.

Also, before booking, it’s worth calling the hotel directly — sometimes they offer small discounts for direct clients.

Overall, I would rate my experience 9.5/10.

I stayed here for a work trip and ended up extending my stay. The room was clean, comfortable, and quiet enough to get good rest after long days. The location made it easy to move around Gurgaon. The staff was genuinely helpful and always greeted with a smile. The food felt fresh and homely, especially dinner.
